title: CryptoWise.AI
tagline: CryptoWise is an AI-powered crypto assistant helping you to invest smarter, better, faster, stronger.  It can help you learn about crypto and support you with research on tokens and projects before you invest. What’s more: it can even execute transactions on your behalf.
description:
CryptoWise is an AI-powered crypto assistant helping you to invest smarter, better, faster, stronger. It can help you learn about crypto or create your own web3 wallet if you're new to web3. If you're a more seasoned investor, it can also support you doing your due diligence on tokens and projects with AI-enabled research – before you ape.

What’s more: it can do swaps, execute transactions on your behalf, or even schedule automated transactions. All this functionality is abstracted away in a neat chat interface, so you only need to be able to type!
how_its_made:
- OpenAI GPT4 --> LLM Agent for for either chat-based responses or transforming user input into a set of on-chain/executional tools
- Safe --> AA for easy onboarding / wallet creation
- Safe --> relayer for sponsored transactions / easy onboarding
- Uniswap --> API for decentralized swaps
- Polygon --> Deploy the smart contract that performs swaps on behalf of the user
-The Graph --> AI agents interfaces with The Graph to look up on chain information based on natural language input
